name: customer_orders_compare_amazon_sales_velocity
description:
Compares CURRENT Amazon sales velocity against prior periods, from placed orders (sp_api_iceberg.orders_v2026) enriched with inventory dimensions (neonpanel_iceberg.inventory_attributes).

Use this tool to:
- See how today's / this week's / this month's sales pace compares to yesterday, last week (7d ago), last month (30d ago), and last year (365d ago)
- Spot fast- and slow-moving products, brands, or product families vs their own history
- Track units_sold, sales (revenue), and average price momentum per group

How the comparison works (period-to-date):
- Pick a granularity: hour, day (default), week, or month. The CURRENT window runs from the start of that bucket up to now.
- Each comparison window is that SAME elapsed window shifted back by a number of days (default 1, 7, 30, 365 = yesterday / last week / last month / last year). So an in-progress day compares fairly against the same slice of prior days.
- Offsets are configurable via comparison_offsets_days (day-based; best suited to hour/day granularity — for week/month use larger offsets like [7, 30, 365]).

Grouping: choose one of inventory_id, sku, asin, product_family, brand, or company_id. Rows are ALWAYS additionally split by company_id x marketplace x currency — sales are NOT currency-converted, so filter by marketplace_ids for single-currency results.

Metrics per window: units_sold (sum of quantity_ordered), sales (sum of item proceeds_total), avg_price (sales / units).

Output columns are dynamic based on the requested offsets:
- current_units_sold, current_sales, current_sales_main, current_avg_price
- prev_<N>d_units_sold, prev_<N>d_sales, prev_<N>d_sales_main, prev_<N>d_avg_price for each offset N
- units_pct_vs_<N>d, sales_pct_vs_<N>d, price_pct_vs_<N>d  (percent change of current vs that prior period, native currency)
plus group_by, company_id, group_value, representative_title, marketplace_id, currency, main_currency.

Currency: *_sales is in the row's native currency; *_sales_main is the same converted to the company's main_currency (app_companies.currency) at each window's order dates (each comparison window uses its own period's FX rates). Main-currency avg price = *_sales_main / *_units_sold; main-currency % deltas derive from the *_sales_main columns.

Dimensions (inventory_id / brand / product_family) come from inventory_attributes joined on company_id + sku; unmapped items return null for those and are excluded when a brand/product_family filter is set. Default limit: 100, ranked by current_sales DESC.

marketplace_ids.description: Amazon marketplace IDs (e.g. 'ATVPDKIKX0DER'). Omit for all. Filter to one for single-currency results.

fulfillment_channels.description: fulfilled_by values: 'AMAZON' (FBA) or merchant ID (FBM). Omit for all.

granularity.description: Size of the current (and each comparison) window.

group_by.description: Dimension to group rows by. Rows are also always split by company_id x marketplace x currency.

comparison_offsets_days.description: Day offsets to compare the current window against. Default 1/7/30/365 = yesterday / last week / last month / last year.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles') or fixed offset (e.g. '-08:00') used for all day/week/month/hour bucketing and the current-time reference. Defaults to America/Los_Angeles (LA), matching NeonPanel reporting. Order timestamps (UTC) are converted to this zone before bucketing.

currency.description: Native currency of this marketplace row.
